snapshots.label: End of 2024 — before the NQCC delivery and the QBI Stage-B cut

entries.statement: Silicon-CMOS spin qubits had credible peer-reviewed manufacturability evidence (record-low charge noise on a customized 300 mm line), but no full-stack system had yet been delivered to an independent evaluator.
entries.note: What the record showed then: manufacturability of qubit devices, yes; an installed system under independent test, no.

entries.statement: PsiQuantum had passed US2QC's R&D-viability stage; final hardware verification was still ahead.
entries.note: Phase-2 standing was a selection fact — design viability assessed on paper, not demonstrated hardware.

entries.statement: Quantum Motion's £62M total funding represented investor confidence; the ledger held zero independent measurements of a delivered Quantum Motion system.
entries.note: The 2024 view already separated capital events from technical evidence — the anti-hype rule pre-existed the findings it now protects.
